subject.title: perf: avoid event-loop stall during embedded_run bootstrap-context

question: Should OpenClaw accept this custom yielding bootstrap glob walker now as the right tradeoff for fixing embedded-run bootstrap event-loop stalls?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent and well covered, but it changes hot bootstrap context behavior that can affect existing extra-bootstrap configs, prompt bytes, and gateway responsiveness; automation cannot safely choose that upgrade tradeoff for maintainers.

options.title: Accept the bounded mitigation
options.body: Merge after base-refresh handling if maintainers accept the custom walker and filesystem-order behavior as the right tradeoff for event-loop liveness.

options.title: Require stronger live proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted live embedded_run or channel-connected proof showing keepalives or timers stay responsive during a broad bootstrap-extra-files scan.

options.title: Pause for traversal policy
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers choose deterministic ordering, traversal budgets, or closer fs.glob parity before replacing Node glob in this path.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded mitigation
recommendation.body: Merge after base-refresh handling if maintainers accept the custom walker and filesystem-order behavior as the right tradeoff for event-loop liveness.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history across the bootstrap reader, bootstrap hooks, and SDK-boundary decisions touched by this PR.
